unresolved_call_decision_groups.rationale: The apparent source is the strictly typed, canonical PrivateDeviceGoalInput and explicit single-use operator arguments passed by the isolated path-rebind adapter, not raw user text or an ambient runtime source. The adapter first verifies the immutable PR #225/#229/#230/#231 packet chain, the precomputed rebound writer/window/operator authorization digests, a lowercase exact launch head, and the lexical caller-owned database-path digest. It then opens only the reviewed writer, window, and operator pin values for one synchronous call and restores all five values in finally. The downstream calls are the already reviewed deterministic goal-selection, lifecycle-transition, event-envelope, SQLite receipt, replay, rollback, canonical-hash, and observation-window paths. Generic hash/file-read findings are static call-graph collisions inherited from existing reviewed helpers and are not new file-read capabilities from this adapter. No expression, speech, publication, network, model, sensor, scheduler, action, runtime integration, legacy authority transfer, migration, M3-E, witness replay, retained-sequence replay, or retry surface is introduced.
unresolved_call_decision_groups.denial_semantics: Import and packet construction perform no I/O. An unreviewed path fails before pin scope and before SQLite construction. The scoped execution is reachable only from the explicit one-time command after clean exact-head attestation, canonical reviewed input, private nonce, exact rebound path digest, absent database/sidecars/outputs, and bounded four-transition checks. Every writer/window/operator pin and the wrapper script bindings are restored on success or failure.
